title: Koko Eating Bananas
summary: Koko needs to eat bananas from n piles at a rate of k bananas per hour to finish all the bananas within h hours.
statement: Koko needs to eat bananas from n piles at a rate of k bananas per hour to finish all the bananas within h hours. Determine the smallest integer k that allows Koko to eat all the bananas before the guards return.
constraints: h is at least the number of piles.
At integer speed k, one pile consumes ceil(pile/k) hours; return minimum feasible k.
reference_solution:
def minimum_eating_speed(piles, h):
 left,right=1,max(piles)
 while left<right:
  speed=(left+right)//2
  if sum((pile+speed-1)//speed for pile in piles)<=h:right=speed
  else:left=speed+1
 return left

hints: Required hours decrease monotonically as speed increases.
Binary-search the first speed whose ceiling-hour sum is at most h.
If feasible move right=mid; otherwise left=mid+1.
Monotonic feasibility preserves the first valid speed inside the search interval.
